question: Under what minimal condition is that entity said to be called supreme Śiva?
premises: An entity is indicated by the demonstrative.
The condition specified is merely the leaving of the body.
Upon that condition, that entity is called supreme Śiva.
inference: Upon merely leaving the body, that entity is called supreme Śiva.
uncertainties: It is not specified whether the designation is ontological or conventional from these tokens alone.
plain_english: Upon merely leaving the body, he is called supreme Śiva.
